concerns.text: FR-006 (Independent Distribution Validation) and SC-001 (Cost of Plausibility) require comparing baseline vs. microcircuit on independent test sets. Task T016 (generate baseline_metrics.json) is marked [ ] (incomplete) and T031 (compare_ablation_results) is marked [ ] (incomplete). Without these tasks being executable, the core validation of the research hypothesis (US1/US3) cannot be performed.

FR-002 (Dynamic E/I Ratio) and FR-007 (Homeostatic Scaling) require dynamic enforcement. Tasks T008c (enforce_ei_ratio) and T019a (apply_scaling_hook) are marked [ ] (incomplete). T008a/b are present but static; the dynamic mechanism required by the spec is missing from the implementation plan.

FR-005 (Cost Curve) and SC-004 (Scaling Exponent) require specific analysis artifacts. Task T029 (generate_cost_curve) and T040 (scaling_analyzer) are marked [ ] (incomplete). The plan lacks the executable steps to generate the 'cost of biological plausibility' curve or calculate the scaling exponent, leaving FR-005 and FR-008 unverified.

FR-003 (Ablation Study) requires systematic disabling of features. While T026a (generate configs) is [X], T026b (run_ablation_study) is [ ] (incomplete). Without executing the ablation runs, the 'cost' cannot be measured, and SC-003 (Performance degradation) cannot be verified.

Constitution Principle V (Versioning Discipline) requires tracking artifacts. Task T001a (create state/template.yaml) is marked [ ] (incomplete). Without the template, the versioning discipline cannot be initialized, blocking the tracking of all subsequent data artifacts.

Task T012c is tagged [US2] but describes an integration test for the microcircuit model (US2) while being listed under 'Tests for User Story 1'. This is a labeling inconsistency that may confuse traceability, though the task content itself is valid for US2.
